episodes.synopsis: Murai is in love with his teacher, Tanaka. After a haircut, he resembles her favorite character.
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: In return for borrowing the game Sengoku Koi Emaki, Murai participates in the Doujinshi Convention.
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: Tanaka, believing Murai deceived her, runs away from the convention only to run into his friends.
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: Yayoi Fukunaga has a happy reunion with Murai, until she finds out he is in love with someone else.
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: Tanaka admits to being worried about Murai. Murai asks for three seconds in return for forgiveness.
episodes.title: Episode 5

episodes.synopsis: Tanaka is worried about Murai dozing off in class. Learning the reason behind it, she goes to him.
episodes.title: Episode 6

episodes.synopsis: The school festival begins. Murai struggles to beat Tanaka's brother, Mao, to gain his approval.
episodes.title: Episode 7

episodes.synopsis: Murai is upset when Yamakado, the second-year head teacher, shows up for homeroom instead of Tanaka.
episodes.title: Episode 8

episodes.synopsis: Tanaka wakes up to find herself at Yamakado's house. Yamakado does something unexpected.
episodes.title: Episode 9

episodes.synopsis: Yamakado asks Tanaka about her relationship with Murai. Something starts to change in Tanaka.
episodes.title: Episode 10

episodes.synopsis: Murai and Tanaka are caught hugging each other on TV. Kiriyama and Yamakado try to save them.
episodes.title: Episode 11

episodes.synopsis: As a child, Murai met and fell in love with Tanaka, but she never realized that the boy was Murai.
episodes.title: Episode 12
